findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_import_status" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Use this after import_menu to see whether the menu is ready. Returns pending, ready (with the menuId and a private ChefBear link to the menu) or failed with a r…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_import_status · Private data: import_menu, get_import_status, get_menu, revoke_menu_share, list_menus, get_shared_menu, save_menu, update_taste_profile · Public sink: import_menu, get_menu, share_menu, revoke_menu_share, get_shared_menu · Destructive: get_menu.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_import_status · Private data: import_menu, get_import_status, get_menu, revoke_menu_share, list_menus, get_shared_menu, save_menu, update_taste_profile · Public sink: import_menu, get_menu, share_menu, revoke_menu_share, get_shared_menu · Destructive: get_menu

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
